# SolversPro Internet Speed Test (Full Context)

> SolversPro Internet Speed Test is an ad-free, high-accuracy network performance measurement tool powered by Cloudflare's global edge network.

## Core Capabilities

- **Download Bandwidth Testing**: Measures real-time downstream data transfer rates up to 1+ Gbps across multiple concurrent chunk streams.
- **Upload Bandwidth Testing**: Measures real-time upstream data transmission directly to Cloudflare edge nodes.
- **Unloaded Ping & Jitter**: Computes baseline round-trip reaction time and latency variance in milliseconds.
- **Loaded Latency (Bufferbloat)**: Accurately evaluates latency under heavy download and upload saturation to reveal router buffer queue delays.
- **Application Performance Grades**:
  - **Online Gaming**: Rated by baseline ping (<30ms) and low jitter (<5ms).
  - **4K Video Streaming**: Rated by sustained download bandwidth (>25 Mbps).
  - **Video Conferencing**: Rated by balanced two-way speed and WebRTC packet stability.
- **Edge Datacenter Telemetry**: Identifies the user's public IP, autonomous system (ISP/ASN), and nearest Cloudflare edge PoP (airport code).

## Related Links
